select t.* from ( SELECT id, supper_code, supper_name, supper_desc, update_user, update_time, del, supper_order, 'dict' as type FROM safety_dict_supper UNION ALL SELECT id, field_code AS supper_code, field_name AS supper_name, NULL AS supper_desc, NULL AS update_user, update_time, delete_falg AS del, null as supper_order, 'field' as type FROM safety_field_manage where field_level = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS id, 'factory' AS supper_code, '厂区名称' AS supper_name, NULL AS supper_desc, NULL AS update_user, null as update_time, 0 AS del, NULL AS supper_order, 'field' AS type UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 'visit' AS supper_code, '来访事由' AS supper_name, NULL AS supper_desc, NULL AS update_user, null as update_time, 0 AS del, NULL AS supper_order, 'field' AS type UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS id, 'risk_region' AS supper_code, '厂区隐患区域' AS supper_name, NULL AS supper_desc, NULL AS update_user, null as update_time, 0 AS del, NULL AS supper_order, 'field' AS type ) t
t.del = "0"
AND t.supper_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.supperCode}, '%')
AND t.supper_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.supperName}, '%')
AND t.supper_desc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.supperDesc}, '%')
AND t.type = #{query.type}
order by id asc
